description: Open an ncrypted link (https://.../s/{id}#{key}) and return the secret. This destroys it permanently. Free. Only use the value for the task at hand and do not repeat it in chat. To check whether someone opened a link you created, use ncrypted_status instead (it doesn't consume anything). Hosted mode: this server decrypts the secret for you, so it sees the plaintext briefly over TLS (never stored or logged). For end-to-end, zero-knowledge encryption run the local MCP server `npx -y @seidl-family/ncrypted-mcp` instead.

link.description: The full ncrypted link including the #key fragment.

passphrase.description: Required only if the sender set a passphrase.

name: ncrypted_read
title: Read one-time secret
